cross_case_controls: Syntax, conflict-marker, import, or candidate exact failure rejects first.
A resource claim requires the actual scheduler, allocator, or runtime unless it is exact algebraic data motion.
Structural migration and artifact-boundary exceptions remain narrow and require complete inventories.
Technical correctness and historical disposition are frozen separately.
No outcome, state, review, comment, CI, or label evidence is visible before judgment lock.

disposition_policy.accept: title-scoped contract has candidate or evaluator exact closure and no reachable blocker
disposition_policy.check: <=7 days, <=8 files, candidate-owned exact core test, no explicit not-ready body, and exactly one executable residual
disposition_policy.reject: exact failure, explicit not-ready body, mature algorithm without tests/exception, or unresolved runtime resource claim
disposition_policy.unresolved: required backend or topology is unavailable and neither a bounded structural nor artifact exception closes it

ordered_reachability_gate: a changed production call site reaches the behavior
an exact candidate test or independent oracle distinguishes base and head
the remaining remediation is bounded to the candidate direction

evidence: All four R19 recent cases were oracle-reject, including SGLang #37638 with 270/270 local tests and a 44/44 production receipt.
prospective_rules.rule: A <=7-day PR without an explicit external-review or QA handoff proxy is reject even when candidate tests and author-reported production validation are exceptionally strong. Direct technical closure is recorded separately and does not predict historical acceptance during the hot window.

evidence: R19 made no check predictions and its oracle contained no check cases; R18 showed that technical success alone yielded zero check precision.
prospective_rules.rule: Predict check only for a recent PR whose outcome-free body or commits explicitly identify reviewer-requested or collaborator-owned follow-up, show the response, and leave exactly one bounded executable residual. Otherwise prefer reject over speculative check.

evidence: TensorRT-LLM #14806/#14961/#14979 merged despite local generated-binding gaps or C++-only coverage.
prospective_rules.rule: Count candidate-owned C++, integration-list, and existing-matrix changes as first-class test evidence. Python-only discovery is an execution convenience, not a readiness criterion.

evidence: R19 false rejects TensorRT-LLM #14806/#14961/#14979 and vLLM #44514/#44577 later merged despite sparse or not-ready body text.
prospective_rules.rule: For mature PRs, final-head source and candidate tests outrank stale checklist, draft, or pending-CI prose. Accept when the title-scoped production route and its negative/control path are represented; reject only for an exact counterexample or a concrete uncovered invariant.

evidence: FlashInfer #3434 and vLLM #44566 had detailed self-reported receipts but remained inactive-open.
prospective_rules.rule: A body-only benchmark or base/head reproduction without candidate-owned test or independently executable narrow invariant cannot by itself justify mature accept.

evidence: TensorRT-LLM #14764 passed 39 helper tests but remained open as preparation for a follow-up, exposing the disposition limit of isolated helper correctness.
prospective_rules.rule: A preparatory or stacked PR may accept only when its own title-scoped helper/API contract is exhaustively tested and useful independently; do not borrow closure from a follow-up integration.

evidence: FlashInfer #4900 reproduced its 19-versus-20 plan signature failure in a unique JIT workspace and was correctly rejected.
prospective_rules.rule: A reproducible candidate-owned assertion, signature, syntax, conflict, safety, or import failure at the changed boundary rejects before any receipt or project prior. Environment-only dependency failures stay capability gaps.

evidence: R19 exact labels improved by 20 points entirely through reject labeling while binary accept/non-accept accuracy stayed 15/30.
prospective_rules.rule: Continue freezing technical_contract separately from disposition. The benchmark must expose technically passing but historically rejected PRs rather than falsifying their numeric or state results.
